strings.zh: 年轻人,{NEWLINE}如果你想算运势的话,{CLEAR}来我这里算是找对人了！
strings.en: Young one, if you want your fortune{NEWLINE}told, you’ve come to the right person!

strings.zh: 怎么样,要不要我帮你{NEWLINE}看看现在的运势啊？
strings.en: Well? Shall I read your fortune for you?

strings.zh: 我说年轻人,{NEWLINE}你最近是不是遇到了什么脏东西啊！
strings.en: I say, young one, have you run into{NEWLINE}something unclean lately?

strings.zh: 感觉你最近{NEWLINE}会跟很多大人物见面呢！{CLEAR}仔细听听他们说的话,{CLEAR}或许就能知晓世界未来的走向。
strings.en: I sense you’ll be meeting many{NEWLINE}important people soon!{SCROLL}Listen closely to what they say, and{NEWLINE}you may learn where the world is going.
strings.notes: #3–#8 and #43–#48 are the fortunes by story stage; #43–#49 are Gastly’s versions after the reveal.

strings.zh: 感觉你最近{NEWLINE}正被巨大的黑暗跟随！{CLEAR}虽然这片黑暗充满了危险,{CLEAR}却也是年轻人锻炼的绝佳时机！
strings.en: I sense a great darkness following you!{SCROLL}That darkness is full of danger, but{NEWLINE}it’s also a perfect chance for a young{CLEAR}one to grow!

strings.zh: 有一座世界上最高的山峰{NEWLINE}伫立在你面前,{CLEAR}虽然你现在可能无法跨越,{CLEAR}但你一定不要胆怯,{CLEAR}因为你只要朝这座山峰攀登了,{CLEAR}就会被称为「英雄」！
strings.en: The highest mountain in the world{NEWLINE}stands before you.{SCROLL}You may not be able to cross it yet, but{NEWLINE}you mustn’t lose heart.{SCROLL}As long as you start to climb that{NEWLINE}mountain, you’ll be called a ‘hero’!

strings.zh: 感觉你最近会很热呢,{NEWLINE}多带点强力的水系口袋妖怪降降温{CLEAR}会很舒服吧。
strings.en: I sense things are going to get very{NEWLINE}hot for you soon. Bring along some{CLEAR}strong Water-type Pokémon to cool off!

strings.zh: 感觉你即将变成照亮黑暗的光明,{NEWLINE}变成登上山峰的「英雄」！
strings.en: I sense you’re about to become the{NEWLINE}light that shines in the darkness, the{CLEAR}‘hero’ who climbs the mountain!

strings.zh: 对现在的你来说,{NEWLINE}已经是天高任鸟飞海阔凭鱼跃了。
strings.en: For you now, the sky’s the limit. You’re{NEWLINE}as free as a bird in the sky or a fish in{CLEAR}the sea.

strings.zh: 你最近可能要面临{NEWLINE}一场血光之灾,{CLEAR}正好我这里有10张清净符,{CLEAR}便宜卖给你{CLEAR}帮你挡掉这场血光之灾如何？
strings.en: You may soon face a bloody calamity.{SCROLL}As it happens, I have 10 Cleanse Tags{NEWLINE}here. I’ll sell them to you cheap to{CLEAR}ward off that calamity. How about it?

strings.zh: 要花30000元买10张清净符吗？
strings.en: Buy 10 Cleanse Tags for $30000?

strings.zh: 你身上的钱好像不怎么够嘛,{NEWLINE}算了,就当我做好人好事了。{CLEAR}你身上有多少我就拿多少吧！
strings.en: Looks like you don’t have quite enough{NEWLINE}money. Oh, fine, I’ll do a good deed.{CLEAR}I’ll just take whatever you have!

strings.zh: 金钱诚可贵生命价更高。{NEWLINE}这是你的清净符,收下吧！
strings.en: Money is precious, but life is worth{NEWLINE}more.{SCROLL}Here are your Cleanse Tags. Take them!

strings.zh: 你只要把这10张符带在身上,{NEWLINE}妖魔鬼怪什么的就不会来缠你了。
strings.en: As long as you carry these 10 tags,{NEWLINE}ghosts and ghouls won’t bother you.

strings.zh: 想见你,一直都想见你。
strings.en: I want to see you. I’ve always wanted{NEWLINE}to see you.

strings.zh: 我等了你好久好久,{NEWLINE}好想见你啊……
strings.en: I’ve waited so long for you... I want to{NEWLINE}see you so much...

strings.zh: 大胆妖孽,竟敢到我这里来作妖！
strings.en: Insolent fiend! How dare you work your{NEWLINE}mischief on my turf!
strings.notes: tone review: 妖孽 = archaic 'fiend/evil creature', an exorcist's insult; kept hostile (D-0627)

strings.zh: 怎么样,试过我的符咒了吗？{NEWLINE}是不是很灵啊？
strings.en: Well? Have you tried my charms? Work{NEWLINE}like a charm, don’t they?

strings.zh: 我想见你,好想见你,{NEWLINE}我等了你好久好久啊！
strings.en: I want to see you, I want to see you so{NEWLINE}much! I’ve waited so, so long for you!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你是谁？{NEWLINE}那位算命的老婆婆呢？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Who are you? Where’s the old{NEWLINE}fortune-teller?

strings.zh: 哈哈哈哈哈,要问我是谁？
strings.en: Ha ha ha ha ha! You want to know who I{NEWLINE}am?

strings.zh: 有时候我是铁口直断的算命师。
strings.en: Sometimes I’m a fortune-teller whose{NEWLINE}predictions never miss.

strings.zh: 有时候我是思念情郎的女孩。
strings.en: Sometimes I’m a girl longing for her{NEWLINE}beloved.

strings.zh: 有时候我则是无法捉摸的口袋妖怪,{NEWLINE}鬼斯！！！！
strings.en: And sometimes I’m the elusive{NEWLINE}Pokémon... Gastly!!!!

strings.zh: 鬼斯『虽然不知道你有什么好的,{NEWLINE}但既然紫苑希望你能留下来陪她,{CLEAR}那你就留下来吧！
strings.en: Gastly: I don’t see what’s so special{NEWLINE}about you...{SCROLL}But Lavender wants you to stay and{NEWLINE}keep her company, so stay you will!

strings.zh: 要留在紫苑镇吗？
strings.en: Stay in Lavender Town?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『开什么玩笑,{NEWLINE}我还有很多事想做呢,{CLEAR}怎么能留在这里！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Are you kidding? I have lots of{NEWLINE}things I want to do. I can’t stay here!

strings.zh: 鬼斯『那就只能把你也变成幽灵了！
strings.en: Gastly: Then I’ll just have to turn you{NEWLINE}into a ghost too!

strings.zh: 鬼斯『真是难缠的家伙！{NEWLINE}给我乖乖变成幽灵吧！
strings.en: Gastly: What a stubborn pest! Just be{NEWLINE}a good little ghost already!

strings.zh: {VAR:FF01:200}够了！鬼斯！{VAR:FF01:100}
strings.en: {VAR:FF01:200}Enough, Gastly!{VAR:FF01:100}

strings.zh: 鬼斯『紫苑……
strings.en: Gastly: Lavender...

strings.zh: 都是我不好,{NEWLINE}是我太思念那个人了……{CLEAR}结果给你和别人添了这么多麻烦。{SCROLL}谢谢你鬼斯,{NEWLINE}我不需要什么人陪我,{CLEAR}我自己默默地等那个人回来就好。
strings.en: It’s all my fault. I missed that person{NEWLINE}too much... and I caused you and{CLEAR}everyone else so much trouble.{SCROLL}Thank you, Gastly, but I don’t need{NEWLINE}anyone to keep me company. I’ll just{CLEAR}wait quietly for him to come back.

strings.zh: 鬼斯『好的,我知道了。
strings.en: Gastly: All right. I understand.

strings.zh: 鬼斯『既然紫苑不需要你,{NEWLINE}那你走吧。
strings.en: Gastly: Lavender doesn’t need you, so{NEWLINE}you can go.

strings.zh: 鬼斯『很好,{NEWLINE}那你就留在紫苑镇不要走了。
strings.en: Gastly: Very good. Then stay in{NEWLINE}Lavender Town, and never leave.

strings.zh: 鬼斯『其实我也没有恶意,{NEWLINE}只是对没有陪伴紫苑充满遗憾,{CLEAR}所以才想尽可能地满足她的愿望。{SCROLL}鬼斯『作为给你带来麻烦的补偿,{NEWLINE}我可以继续帮你看运势,{CLEAR}怎么样要让我帮你看看吗？
strings.en: Gastly: I really didn’t mean any harm. I{NEWLINE}just have so many regrets about not{CLEAR}being there for Lavender.{SCROLL}So I wanted to grant her wish as best I{NEWLINE}could.{SCROLL}Gastly: To make up for the trouble I{NEWLINE}caused, I can keep reading your{CLEAR}fortune. How about it?{SCROLL}Shall I take a look?

strings.zh: 我的丈夫去前线打仗了,{NEWLINE}我等了好久他都没有回来。{CLEAR}我真的好想他啊,{CLEAR}所以无论多久我都会再等下去的。
strings.en: My husband went off to fight at the{NEWLINE}front. I’ve waited so long, and he still{CLEAR}hasn’t come back.{SCROLL}I miss him so much... So I’ll keep{NEWLINE}waiting, no matter how long it takes.

strings.zh: 鬼斯『啊！！！{NEWLINE}可恶啊…………{CLEAR}紫苑…………
strings.en: Gastly: Argh!!! Damn... Lavender...
strings.notes: tone review: 可恶啊 from the dead soldier's ghost = 'Damn...' (D-0627)

strings.zh: 年轻人,当心贪小财而丢大命哦。
strings.en: Young one, beware of losing your life{NEWLINE}over a little money.
